Market today: The market mood is cautious, with rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions potentially fueling inflation fears. This, combined with significant market cap losses for major tech players like Tesla, suggests headwinds for your concentrated tech/chip portfolio.

Your holdings: Your book is flashing red, especially the leveraged ETFs. SOXL is down a staggering 81.82%, MUU is down 66.07%, and SMCI is down 38.29%. These deep drawdowns are amplified by margin and demand immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on oil price movements and any further signs of weakness in bellwether tech stocks. Also, monitor the defense sector for potential diversification.

Bottom line: Your leveraged tech/chip positions are under severe pressure; risk management is paramount right now.
plays: SOXL: Your 3X leveraged SOXL is down 81.82% at $40.87, with a stop at $200. This stop is clearly blown; re-evaluate this position immediately to manage margin risk.
MUU: This 2X leveraged ETF is down 66.07%. Consider trimming to reduce exposure and free up margin, especially with its SELL status.
